_comment: Feel + SFX for the animated observation box (drop-in, typewriter reveal, manual dismiss). Sound paths are placeholders (observe.ogg) until the OST pass supplies real SFX; swap them here, no code change. drop_in_secs = entrance slide/fade; chars_per_sec = typewriter speed; fade_out_secs = fade on dismiss; blip_every = play a tick every N characters; max_width_frac = body wraps within this fraction of the window.
